simple: Protection for collaboration apps — a component of FortiMail Workspace Security: Microsoft Teams, Slack, Zendesk, Salesforce and the OneDrive, Google Drive, SharePoint and AWS S3 cloud storage. Instantly scans all files, links and messages with the same engines as email (static analysis, dynamic analysis on the HAP platform, AI), so malware and phishing don’t spread through chats, storage and CRM. The FortiMail Workspace Security suite includes Fortinet’s 24/7 incident response service at no extra cost: it analyzes alerts, tunes policies and helps with remediation.
